cues.speaker: Chief
cues.en: Hey! No eating and drinking binges on expenses!

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: W-what are you talking about?

cues.speaker: Chief
cues.en: Don't play dumb. Metal Gear sends me all the data.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Metal?

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Th-that's why I warned you.

cues.speaker: Chief
cues.en: Don't let it happen again.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: What kind of medicine is this?

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: I'll analyze it.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Antacids, mucosal protectants, H2 blockers.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Medicine for stomach ulcers.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Gibson had serious stomach trouble, yet he ate whale meat.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: There's something behind this. He must have had a reason to eat it.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: We're back at JUNKER HQ.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: We're back.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Going inside. We're at the front desk.

cues.speaker: Mika
cues.en: I heard about Jean, Gillian.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: I'm sorry. I was too inexperienced.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: You did well, Gillian.

cues.speaker: Mika
cues.en: That's right, Gillian. It wasn't your fault.

cues.speaker: Mika
cues.en: The Chief is waiting, Gillian.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: The Chief's office.

cues.speaker: Chief
cues.en: A rough start to your new job, Seed. Well done.

cues.speaker: Chief
cues.en: Metal Gear's data showed me what happened at the scene.

cues.speaker: Chief
cues.en: I'm sorry about Gibson. Carry on for him too, Seed.

cues.speaker: Chief
cues.en: You're the only one who can fight the Snatchers now.

cues.speaker: Harry
cues.en: Well, the JUNKER returns.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: I'm detecting alcohol. He seems drunk.

cues.speaker: Harry
cues.en: I thought you were more capable than this. What good was the backup?

cues.speaker: Harry
cues.en: If you'd been a little more capable, Jean might not have had to die.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: That's not true, Harry.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: It's all right, Metal. Harry's right.

cues.speaker: Harry
cues.en: Jean... I'm sorry, lad. It wasn't your fault.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Metal, give Harry Little John's memory chip,

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: the one we found at the scene.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Understood. Here's Little John's memory, Harry.

cues.speaker: Chief
cues.en: Let's go over your report again. Metal Gear, if you would.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Yes. I'll play back the footage I recorded.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: After Gibson contacted you,

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: you went straight to the factory ruins in the M district.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Someone had murdered Gibson inside the factory ruins.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Hair and skin found on his body suggest two Snatchers killed him,

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: one male and one female.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Gibson's investigation records on the floppy disk

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: revealed a serious weakness in the Snatchers.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: It seems the Snatchers killed Gibson because he discovered it.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Their weakness lies in how they differ from real humans.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Prolonged UV exposure makes their artificial skin cancerous.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: It develops a form of malignant melanoma.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: This limits where and when they can operate.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Only at night, in midwinter when the days are short.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Their artificial skin needs at least six months to stabilize.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Those six months are their weakness.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: They must stay out of UV light for that entire time.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Gibson must have uncovered this using his skills

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: as a former Science Cop.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: That's why they wore sunscreen, even in midwinter.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: All this means they need one thing to survive.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: A hospital that can maintain their cancerous artificial skin.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Gibson may have found the hospital doing that maintenance.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: To retrace Gibson's steps, you followed the whale meat in his

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: stomach to Outer Heaven, the only restaurant that serves it.
